0022600090.text: Both the Indiana Pacers and New Orleans Pelicans open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season matchup, with the Pacers on the road. The teams split their two meetings in 2025-26, and the most recent was a 127-119 Indiana win in Indiana on January 16, 2026. The Pacers are without Johnny Furphy, who is out following knee surgery, though ESPN's matchup predictor gives Indiana a 65% chance of winning.
